blocks.text: Isabelle Daza has fulfilled her promise to help a village in Tanay, Rizal, gain access to clean drinking water after a water pump and solar panels were finally installed in the community. Daza took to Instagram on Friday, Oct. 23 to share highlights of her visit to Ave Maria, where she showed the newly installed facilities, including a submersible water pump, an off-grid solar power system and water storage tanks for residents. “I want to show you guys my biggest flex to date.
